newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch rhino horn thief steals plastic replica.
newsitem.headline: Dutch rhino horn thief steals plastic replica.

text.p: A Dutch thief who stole what he believed was a rhinoceros horn from a university actually stole a plastic replica designed to thwart robbers, officials said on Friday.

"It was quite a good lookalike," said Martin Loonen at Groningen University. "We originally had the real horn with the skeleton, but a colleague who had been in Africa said that was crazy as it would probably be stolen. I suppose he was right."
Loonen said the thief might have got the idea from a recent Dutch magazine article which had recounted the myth that powdered horn is a powerful aphrodisiac.

It was not known whether the plastic horn would be toxic if ingested, he said, but added the thief was likely to be very disappointed with the effect of any experiment. "I hope so, I really hope so," Loonen said.
